info.title: 555 PWM motor controller
info.question: How does a pulse train control motor speed?
info.expected: The 555 drives an N-channel MOSFET; armature inductance, inertia and flyback conduction smooth the motion between pulses.
info.try: Select P1 to change timer timing/duty; select MTR1 to change load and watch RPM/current. Compare motor voltage/current, gate pulses and D1 flyback current.
info.limitation: Generic brushed DC motor: armature RL, reciprocal Ke=Kt electromechanical coupling, rotor inertia, viscous friction and load. No brushes, commutation ripple, thermal model, gearbox or hardware ratings.

potentiometer_model.limitations: Generic linear three-pin resistive track. Total resistance is split into two segments, each with 1 ohm endpoint resistance. Position 0 is toward pin 2; position 1 is toward pin 1. No contact noise, nonlinear taper, ratings, heating or physical part identity.

diode_model.limitations: Generic silicon junction with Shockley forward/reverse leakage and finite series resistance; no reverse breakdown, capacitance, charge storage, thermal dynamics, ratings or physical part identity.

body_diode.limitations: Generic silicon junction with Shockley forward/reverse leakage and finite series resistance; no reverse breakdown, capacitance, charge storage, thermal dynamics, ratings or physical part identity.

nmos_model.limitations: Generic enhancement NMOS with square-law channel, channel-length modulation and source-to-drain body diode. Body tied to source; zero gate current. No subthreshold conduction, body effect, gate/junction capacitance, charge storage, switching loss, breakdown, heating, ratings or named device identity. External capacitors provide circuit timing.

timer555_model.limitations: Generic CMOS 555 functional model: trigger below half control sets the latch; threshold above control resets it when trigger is not low; active-low reset has priority. Three 100 kΩ divider segments give nominal 1/3 and 2/3 supply thresholds. Fixed 50 Ω output, 10 Ω discharge, 1 GΩ input/off paths and 50 kΩ supply load. Supply below 2 V forces the latch low with output/discharge off; above 12 V refuses simulation. No physical part identity, rated output current, propagation delay, internal charge, noise, heating, tolerance or frequency qualification.

power_model.battery: Linear charge reservoir: OCV=Vfull*q/Q; Q=3600*capacity_Ah; ESR voltage sag. Equivalent stored energy=Q*Vfull*SOC^2/2. No chemistry, temperature, ageing, self-discharge, protection or physical ratings. Positive delivered current discharges; externally forced charging is an ideal reversible reservoir, not a charger model. Startup SOC is 0..1; live SOC outside that range is reported, not hidden.
power_model.motor: Generic brushed DC motor: armature RL, reciprocal Ke=Kt electromechanical coupling, rotor inertia, viscous friction and load. No brushes, commutation ripple, thermal model, gearbox or hardware ratings.
power_model.optocoupler: Generic LED/phototransistor optocoupler: separate conductive input/output ports, CTR and smooth saturation. No isolation-voltage rating, capacitance, propagation delay, temperature or ageing model.
power_model.transformer: Linear mutually coupled windings with series resistance and dot polarity. No core saturation, hysteresis, losses beyond winding resistance or isolation rating. Coupling below one gives a positive-definite inductance matrix.
